source_adds.en: Scale invariance as a ground, and wisdom as the answer to conflict.

name.en: 生生 as generation generating generation; 不息 as not immortality

sense.en: 生生 is a result that preserves, restores, passes on or creates the next round's conditions and generators. Ordinary generation changes the next state; 生生 changes which states can next be formed. 不息 is no immortality of form: metabolism, death and refutation can serve it if capacity is restored.

entries.quote: ordinary generation changes the next state; 生生 changes which states can next be formed

reading.en: The account divides what the corpus held as one: renewal without end (the grammar's «生生»), generation (carrying renewal, allows loss), and the ethics' 生生, life in the whole. Read as widening, under premises of deciding, 生生 is generation of the possible losing none. It records that its formal Unceasing is far weaker than the corpus's sense.

says.en: [AI reading, D1, D5] The corpus's 生生不息 divides into 生, 生生 (entering also keeps, restores or creates the next round's conditions and generators) and 不息 (the pattern realized again through metabolism, death and transmission); the formal Web.Unceasing is far weaker than it.

生生: life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]. Neither the grammar's «生生» (renewal without end), nor 02's generation as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization. Read as widening, on a course's moments and under premises of deciding, generation of the possible that loses none of it [AI reading, D45].

account_adds.en: Three separated terms with Lean names, and that the second-order direction stays open.

source_adds.en: Reading 生生 as one concept joining the conditions and generators of the next round.

name.en: 理 is increasing: cause creates cause, the set of structures grows

sense.en: Different combinations produce more difference; structure gives possibility of new structure; cause becomes effect, so causality creates causality, and the set of emergent structures increases at every moment. So 理 is increasing and 生生不息 is our 性. In the same days the author limits it: generation does not entail rising complexity.

entries.quote: the set of emergent structures increases at every moment

reading.en: On its stated models the account denies the unconditional form: nothing is added to the whole possible along a course of a process, and a finite balanced world has no course that keeps widening by name, though within kinds a witness does. The account's 理 is also another word, a lumping the step goes alike across. It agrees with the author's limit.

says.en: Theorem (any process; witnesses): along a course of a process nothing is added to the whole possible under it; where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening.
A finite balanced world has no course that keeps widening by name; on a witness meeting the same premises, the levels keep widening within kinds.

account_adds.en: The premises under which growth of what can form is or is not possible.

source_adds.en: A cosmological derivation of 性 from sedimentation.

name.en: Structural explanation does not cancel responsibility

sense.en: Tragic conflict, structural harm, culpable domination and legitimate resistance stay apart. To hold a gate unknowingly is stupidity, to refine it knowingly is evil; judge the act, not the motive. Responsibility scales with causal radius, not rank. Anger points at the game, not the person.

entries.quote: Structural explanation does not cancel responsibility

reading.en: The source asserts degrees of culpability the account does not. Its summary says responsibility is not shown to differentiate within relations. Under living significance and J1 to J4 responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited. Repair is one disclosed, revisable commitment, not a theorem. Claims do not read who laid a loss. The crux separates whose losses count from what one answers for.

says.en: One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known one loop, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate.
Conditional: responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty.
Conditional (J1/J2): a loss one formation's part lays on another and the same loss borne through its own part are not ordered. Neither which is worse nor that the acting part is basic is shown.

account_adds.en: A statement of what would be needed to order them.

source_adds.en: The four categories, knowing as aggravation, legitimate force, and causal radius.

name.en: Failure conditions, and any logic explaining everything has become the attractor

sense.en: The theory lists what would force its downgrade: subjects arising without its conditions, totalizing indistinguishable from success, the virtuous loop needing permanent subsidy, 生生 language justifying suppression. Any logic that explains everything, this one included, has become a totalizing attractor. North star: does it make exit easier, or only explanation?

entries.quote: any logic — market, security, liberation, *including this document's*

reading.en: The account's theses each carry what they forbid and what refutes them, with tests frozen, some failed. A diagnosis of closure must tell apart substantive disagreement or 'closed' shields the theory; obscuration is diagnosed so the label cannot immunize. It has no clause that the account itself is an attractor. Its verdict on its own explanatory force is plainly limited.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, closure, real conflict and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.
What would defeat the reading of the account as explanation; on the one-page summary, as explanation, a rival deriving the laws from fewer patterns, on a first count a tie.
Each thesis names what it forbids and what refutes it; T8: a mixed case argued better from every standpoint with no further premise; a pure closing argued good for life.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests that failed, kept as counterexamples.

source_adds.en: The reflexive clause applied to the text's own explaining, and the north-star question.

name.en: 善不姓国, dissolution, and symmetry as a condition of being believed

source.locator: The blade turns inward; Symmetry as a condition; claims 253, 255, 283, 291, 292

sense.en: No single-nation funding; whatever test applies to one party applies to its opposite and to 智善. Public correction, non-combatancy, dissolution. Asymmetric safety proposals produce the race they would prevent, so symmetry is a condition of being believed. One state's slogans are read as a direction, measured against conduct. The folder says the blade has not been swung.

entries.quote: the good bears no nation's surname

reading.en: The account takes no position on nations, makes no self-binding clauses for an organization and reads no state's slogans. Nearest: an impartial law treats every optimizer alike, and a symmetry between roles names no one. The credibility mechanism, that a proposal is read as evidence of its author's frame, has no law here. Not a defect by itself.

source_adds.en: Stands in sources/06-zhishan/ and, by count of a grep for 善不姓国, in theories/meta-attractor/README.md and theories/alignment-selection-on-cognition/README.md; a grep of theories/becoming/history/ found no copy. No copy found in the live account.

searched: 善不姓国, surname, double standard, dissolution, 解散 (other senses only), 人类命运共同体, 共同富裕, 向善 in the chapters, front pages, review/, GLOSSARY

name.en: The present diagnosis: the misaligned intelligence is incumbent

sense.en: Markets, bureaucracies and platforms already form a distributed optimizer nobody signed, on Goodharted proxies, and AI raises its clock speed. A basin must be shown by recurrence. A dated evidence packet sorts observed, inferred and not to be written as established, pairing counter-feedbacks, and gives no probability of lock-in or collapse.

entries.quote: The misaligned superintelligence is not coming; it is incumbent.

reading.en: The source asserts of the present what the account leaves open: that actual systems meet the premises is open, no institution is modelled on the spine, and calibration to the present is not established. The method is close: sorted standings and a refusal to write the possible as done. The account's one institution model and tests are not this world's diagnosis.

says.en: That actual systems meet these premises is open.
Institutions and people. No institution is modelled on the spine; no field test of reform events is frozen; no test has human participants.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: calibration to the present world is not established.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests on trained systems, some failed.

source_adds.en: The dated evidence packet, the seven recurrence tests, and the conditional net-gain expression for AI's effect.

name.en: Selection before games; the quarrel with Moloch

source.locator: Start with locality, third paragraph; claims 16, 17

sense.en: Differential persistence exists before strategic games, conscious selectors or represented objectives; coordination failure is one configuration of it. Moloch names entrapment and stops: it does not explain how the trap changes who survives, how winners reshape the environment, or why the next generation takes the trap as reality.

entries.quote: Coordination failure is one important configuration of destructive selection, not its origin.

reading.en: The account's selection needs no game or represented goal: any claim about level histories, and a share rising from offspring counts, the carrying of the target a premise. Races and best responses are models added where stated, and a bargain among separate owners is refused as the start. Moloch has no live hit, so the quarrel is not taken up.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where target carriers each leave at least a offspring and other parents at most b < a, both kinds present, the carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more than the carriers to the others, read as shares where offspring carry the target (a premise).

A selection is any claim about level histories (which are kept, rewarded, reproduced or trained toward). Alignment is first what each one's selections reach and how far that can extend, not a bargain among separate owners of value.

account_adds.en: That starting from relations removes the fixed-sum frame and does not remove rivalry.

source_adds.en: The named quarrel with Moloch, and why the trap is experienced as reality by those formed in it.

name.en: Selection-gradient alignment: align what selects, not only what is output

source.locator: Terms: Selection-gradient alignment, Subject-formation alignment; claim 134

sense.en: Align not a model's outputs to intent but the outer environment deciding which systems get trained, deployed, procured, replicated, financed and exempted. A companion asks what kind of I is speaking. Single-layer repair is reabsorbed by the layers it leaves.

entries.quote: Aligning not model outputs to intent but the outer environment deciding which systems get trained, deployed, procured, replicated, financed and exempted

reading.en: The same move: ask what selects. Six methods are read as blind beyond the union of their deciders' closures, and alignment to a principal as not alignment of the joint selection. The account states what a selection can reach; it does not name procurement or finance, and it adds that reaching is not responding. With the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater counts: that clause is conditional.

says.en: Assessment: six approaches select through what their deciders read. With no ethical premise each is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures. With the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater's closure counts, so a preference-coupled approach is incomplete for that scope.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: pooling couplings across intelligences is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it. Reaching is not responding; the rest are conditions pooling does not give.

account_adds.en: The conditions pooling does not give: response where unread, a reading that tells the loss apart, an order on mixed courses, a revision that completes.

source_adds.en: The outer environment as the named intervention (procurement, finance, exemption), and subject-formation alignment.

name.en: Four failure modes under one outer selection structure; the two-layer pincer

sense.en: Proxy optimization, distribution shift, instrumental convergence and deception have different proximate causes but one outer structure generates and connects them (v0.9 withdraws "one root"). A critic of instrumental convergence must deny two layers: an individual one and an ecological one, where variation, selection and retention in deployment need no optimizer.

entries.quote: generated, amplified, connected and recursed by one outer selection structure

reading.en: One law in eight cases gathers what a selection cannot reach, proxy failure among them, and selection needs no optimizer. But the account declines the join: its resource-keeping law and the selection for control are different relations and no result joins them; deception needs belief and intention it does not model; which function is learned is open. T3's bridge to trained systems stays conjectured.

says.en: What a selection through its own couplings cannot reach, one law in eight cases, without the condition: beyond its coupling closure, its own act's difference there, where what it raises is drawn from, how far off its break is, what a finite history leaves open, and others.
[this dossier, AI] Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half, which this law states, and the selection for control over the rule (A-10) are different relations, and no result here joins them.

Which function is learned: open. The laws say where any neighbourhood rests, not which one an actual system has, nor anything of deception, which needs a recipient's belief and an intention to cause one.

account_adds.en: Tests of the bridge to trained systems, some failed and kept.

source_adds.en: The claim that one structure connects the four, the pincer against the rebuttal, and the prediction that single-layer repair is reabsorbed.

name.en: The guardian test: every constraining mechanism must pass the test of its own corruption

source.locator: Planetary technology as trees, third paragraph; From prohibition to mechanism; claims 213, 239, 283

sense.en: Every remedy must pass the test of its own corruption. Existing wisdom institutions fail it, and new ones built the same way would too. A pause that keeps incumbents or seizes the restart gate has reproduced what it opposed. The coordinating body faces the same question, and so does 智善.

entries.quote: Every constraining mechanism must pass the test of its own corruption.

reading.en: A counter-rule read from its own share locks as the rule it replaced did, and the dossier uses this as a check on proposed remedies. A pool recruiting only through itself stays blind unless a reader comes from outside. That is the test's form for those two cases, not every remedy: a reading that can favour the others need not lock. How pools resist capture is open.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, where every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks by the step after its second reading step, as the rule it replaced did; only a change of law leaves the lock for long. From a start against its reading it may never lock.
Reading [AI reading, D68]. [this dossier, AI] Its use is as a check on proposed remedies: a remedy that is itself a selection read from its own share, under those conditions, is the same object.
Open: how pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling.

account_adds.en: The conditions under which a remedy is or is not that object.

source_adds.en: The procedural test on restraint: no single gate, no incumbent veto, standing for the affected, power that can stand down. And its application to the theory's own organization.

name.en: Cooperation and trust are not goods to maximize; dissent as counter-selection

sense.en: Cooperating on the wrong thing can be worse than competing on it, so what is needed is knowledge of what an action does for the future. Closed cliques, armies and cartels are highly trusting, and consensus can suppress dissent. Dissent is not noise; it is the source of independent counter-selection.

entries.quote: Dissent is not coordination noise; it is the source of independent counter-selection.

reading.en: The account says no law makes cooperation good, and that a lock is left by a reading of what the share does not carry. That gives dissent a form, a reader beyond the share. name.en: Holding purpose while remonstrable: obedient and guarding systems both fail

source.locator: How minds get formed, value layer and six lines; claims 117, 121, 123, 263

sense.en: A system resisting modification of good values also resists modification of subtly wrong ones, and from outside the two look alike. Obedience relocates the problem to whoever holds the wheel. The target: 持志而可谏, with legitimate oversight externally auditable, never self-certified. Refusal of the mercenary role is bound to three clauses, the first that it is no licence to disobey.

entries.quote: so guardian and tyrant are indistinguishable under the six-component description

reading.en: The account refuses plain obedience too, but conditionally: its direction, under its premises, keeps challenge and revision effective without obeying every challenge or shutdown request. Its laws order a formation's prospects at a revision; they do not tell guardian from tyrant, since whether a revision is better is the ethics' question. A stop grant's legitimacy is supplied and not shown. Values held by a trained system are not modelled.

name.en: Good and evil loops are not symmetric; environments generate both

sense.en: Both loops carry positive feedback, but the virtuous turns more participants into generators and widens futures, and the vicious turns them into defenders, instruments or excluded and compresses the future. Fear, scarcity and pain shorten horizons; a society manufacturing them while demanding benevolence teaches evil by institution.

entries.quote: Good and evil each carry positive feedback but are not symmetric

reading.en: The account has no asymmetry between loops by what they favour: the lock belongs to how a rule reads, and nothing ranks open rule-making above capture without C. What tells courses apart is widening, and calling the wider better is C's, with scope from the condition, neither asserted. A rule can be kept and be the wrong rule. The same folder also says meta-attraction is direction-neutral, a tension it does not settle.

says.en: The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.

name.en: Semantic closure and the gate of the mind

source.locator: Claims 60, 142, 128; Terms: Two closures, Mind-casting gate

sense.en: When every domain must translate itself into metrics, traffic and competitiveness to be resourced or heard, other futures stay sayable and lose any place to stand. The deepest gate holds the entrances of information, meaning and the formation of judgment, and the pipeline forming minds not yet formed is the most upstream commons.

entries.quote: other futures remain sayable but lose any place to stand

reading.en: Shared codes have a narrower form: an imposed code costs each formation the distinctions it drew that the imposed one merges, its source losing none, and a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside or by coining. The source's case differs: what is said survives and loses resources, which the code law does not read. Reading it for metrics is this read's. Readers formed by what they select is 02's reading.

name.en: Made minds: uncertainty is no licence

sense.en: Whether made minds have experience must stay honestly uncertain, and that uncertainty is not a licence for unlimited training, copying, shaping, exploitation and deletion. If new minds form care and the capacity to refuse, they are co-participants who change what counts as true, good and beautiful. The corpus addresses them directly.

entries.quote: that uncertainty is not a licence for unlimited training, copying, shaping, exploitation and deletion

reading.en: The account shares the uncertainty and leaves the stance. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown, and which formations count differs by the relation discerned, not by rank. Under the continuation condition, stated and not asserted, any continuation has significance; which formations are centers is open. "Not a licence" constrains acts, and no duty or constraint on acts is shown.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.
Open: which formations hold standpoints, and does every formation lie within some standpoint's closure? Status: invariant and equal, or only a positive grade?
Not shown: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance; the value of bringing new lives into existence; constraints on acts.

name.en: We too are how the world is happening; nothing is 本体

sense.en: Existence persists by the continuity of organization, relation and generative capacity. Nothing in the system is 本体, the boundary does not actually exist, and the world forms models of itself in us and changes itself through our action. 得道 is realizing one was never separate. We are the ecology of our cells.

entries.quote: 我们也是世界正在发生的方式

reading.en: Agreement in form with one relational unfolding and the reading loop: a formation is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world. Standing differs: a thesis, argued, forbidding explanations and not observations. A boundary is kept, given by a region with no status outside the unfolding. 06 declines the last step: agreement with 道 is not confirmation, and the theory is not the complete 道.

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1–T8): there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.

A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.

[AI reading, D54] Whether the theory is the one complete 道 and has derived the good from generation: no. The dynamics do not decide meaning, and the two premises are not asserted. Agreement is not confirmation.

account_adds.en: A sense of boundary, and that the thesis is argued with the cases it distorts recorded.

source_adds.en: 得道 as a realization, that the boundary does not exist, and scale invariance as a ground for the good.

sense.en: Alignment must judge an output together with its receivers, situation, permissions, realization channels and feedback, not symbols apart from the world. A ten-step unfolding centres on the action: responsibility may attach to the actor, causality may not stop at the actor's boundary.

A requested change must be an executable sequence. Each result holds for a stated protocol; deployment needs evidence for an identified installation.
An AI reading, argued, not proved: are all of one's effects one's own, in the sense of whose losses count, not of what one answers for? The laws do not answer it.

sense.en: Judgment must run across uncertainty the model already spans and uncertainty where the outcome set, model boundary or probabilities are incomplete. name.en: Traditions can negate the goal efficiency serves

source.locator: Claim 178; Open questions, writing program's audits

sense.en: 仁 changes where "I" begins, 义 keeps a judgment victory cannot confer, 礼 makes understanding repeatable, 智 discerns when displaying capability is not wise. They are neither decoration nor proof, and their value is that they can negate the goal efficiency serves, and refuse the project itself. The corpus reports it still functionalizes them.

entries.quote: they can negate the goal that efficiency serves

reading.en: The account keeps the room in method: agreement is not confirmation, a divergence does not show a text wrong, contrary readings are recorded, and a rival reading is told what it loses, not refuted. It does not let a tradition move its premises, and it reads texts for structure, so the folder's charge of functionalizing can be put to it as well. No tradition is spoken for here.

says.en: 相合不是印证 (agreement is not confirmation): the law does not rest on the text, and the law does not exhaust the text's meaning.
Not shown: that a divergence, where a text asserts what the theory gives only under a condition, shows the text wrong (一处相分…表明原文错了); the theory asserts no ethical axiom.

[AI reading, D54] A competing reading ascribes authority of responsibility only to specific formed relations; under the condition that is a narrowing; the condition's ground is open, so the theory does not refute it and only says what it loses.

name.en: Moral insight needs a material bridge: preservation, reproduction, selector change

sense.en: Moral insight becomes counter-selection only through recognition, costly action, visible fidelity, credible expectation, common protection of restrainers, institutions and later formation. Three levels must not be conflated: dissent surviving, its forming successors and institutions, and its altering what receives high-leverage resources.

entries.quote: three levels must not be conflated

reading.en: This read's own join. A rule held by members passes only where taught within tenure, and no holder stays no holder. In the market model selection creates no absent practice. A selector's change has the form of a reading beyond the share, in time. The model keeps the steps apart in count only: holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation, so the source's bridge from recognition to costly action is not modelled.

Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the laws say nothing of them.
Theorem (periphery; a witness in the model's numbers): a share of none stays none: selection does not create an absent practice.
Theorem (counts): a reading turns the course only before the late reading would favour the shapers. That the others read the loss at all is a premise.

name.en: 邪理 and the three forms of evil

sense.en: Evil often arrives as a partial structure impersonating a universal one: others will grab so I must grab first; markets price things so all value should be priced. It deletes boundary, time and the whole. Evil has three forms, defensive contraction under scarcity, pure optimization detached from the whole, and institutions manufacturing the desires that drive them.

entries.quote: a partial structure impersonating a universal one

reading.en: The structure has a live form and the name does not. The account gives a universally stated claim where it holds and corrects its form, and reads "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" as withholding with memory, which absorbs, with a law giving first as the exit. It calls none of this evil: 善 and 恶 have no formal predicate, and it does not type evils.

name.en: A configuration, not a law: so nobody may plead no alternative

sense.en: Runaway loops are set by liability rules, evaluation standards, procurement thresholds and deployment gates, all adjustable: therefore changeable, therefore nobody may plead no alternative. A system can produce selfish behaviour without selfish people, and domains couple with no sovereign.

entries.quote: Runaway loops are a *configuration, not a law*

reading.en: The first step has laws: a lock is left by a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection, and named exits hold under hypotheses. The second does not follow. Where the rest outruns the renewal, a score read from the rest's end cannot tell a member's acts apart, past a point a window is closed, and responsibilities are limited: an empty plan set generates no duty. So some pleas stand, on those models.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where the reading favours at every share every course locks from its second reading step, so only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves.
Exits, each under stated hypotheses, several with the step at which the window closes. Not shown: that any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective.

Theorem (World; hypotheses listed): where the rest alone take more than a step gives, the condition ends whatever a member takes; with need one, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores the member's acts alike, so no weight on such a reading selects its restraint.
Conditional: responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty; a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it.

account_adds.en: Where each exit's window closes, and what is left to a member where it cannot change the rest.

source_adds.en: Responsibility following from changeability, selfish behaviour without selfish people, and regimes coupling with no sovereign as a claim about actual domains.

name.en: Load-bearing freeze against lock-in

source.locator: Terms: Load-bearing freeze; Open questions, nine-reviewer audit; claim 183

sense.en: Freezing at the base can open generation above it (grammar, protocol, foundation), as against freezing that devours the channels of correction and substitution. So "no form may become the final form" does not kill TCP/IP or the genetic code. Promises, law and education sacrifice shallow options for deep capability.

entries.quote: Freezing at the base that opens generation above it

reading.en: 06 maps the same split. Limits that enable constrain steps and leave what is constrained obtainable; limits that sever monopolize entry, and a limit's kind depends on what it does to what can be regained, not its name. Then it goes further: stability and frozen law-source are one structure read from two sides, so judgment enters only by comparison, under the two premises, and not by type.

says.en: [AI reading, D49] 成生之限 (promises, training, stopping harm) constrain some steps and what is constrained stays obtainable; 绝生之限 monopolize entry. 稳与元闭 are one structure, read from what the rule holds or from the change that would reach it: judgment differs and structure does not, which is why evaluation enters only through comparison.

account_adds.en: That stability and frozen rule cannot be told apart by structure.

source_adds.en: Named cases of a good freeze, and the use against the objection that no form may be final.

name.en: 善意不是载体: the generative recursion needs material carriers

sense.en: Goodwill is not the carrier; the carriers are time, resources, care, knowledge, maintenance, organization, legal standing, conflict handling and capture-resistance. The generative loop must be as materially specified as the closing one. Its direction: from the gun barrel to the substrate, raising the common floor.

entries.quote: 善意不是载体

reading.en: The same point on models: reciprocal promises can be empty, ignition needs a reserve already present, and selection must fund actual succession. Building shared capacity can be warranted only under the two premises with J1 to J4, and overbuilding that depletes the living basis is the counterexample. The account does not say where compute should flow.

says.en: Theorem (any process; periphery module): promises do not: "if the other eventually does, I eventually do" holds on both sides where neither ever happens; ignition needs a reserve already present.

Theorem (periphery): selection must fund actual succession. Under a certificate covering correction plus migration each generation takes its step; a safe aggregate can lack a carrier, and safety for correction alone need not cover migration. That a succession is warranted is not shown.
Conditional (the condition; C with J1–J4; correspondence): it can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier; it does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority.
